'''Imrai''' was a village located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]] that was home to [[Kajin Savaros]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] and a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] came to the village looking for the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Savaros.<ref name="Patterns" />
